title: Less Shelf Chaos, More Surgical Flow
subtitle: Case cart improvements at OU Health
role: Data Analyst, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt project
description: Analyzed Sterile Processing Department supply operations supporting about 90 surgeries a day and redesigned how case carts get stocked and prepared.
highlights: Built a centralized inventory dataset and dashboards tracking supply usage, restock frequency, and inventory levels
Analyzed the top 50 high-volume surgical supplies to flag overstocked and understocked items and recommend new par levels
Applied DMAIC with SIPOC, value stream mapping, and FMEA to find the root causes of delays
Recommended optimized storage layouts, standardized labeling, and barcode-based inventory tracking
impact: Recommendations projected to save 2,000+ labor hours a year

title: Turning Data into Dollars
subtitle: Chickasaw Nation Gaming Commission case competition
description: Analyzed patron behavior, geographic revenue, and demographic engagement to find high-value customer segments and the risks facing future revenue.
highlights: Cleaned and transformed large gaming datasets in Python using Google Colab
Built dashboards in Power BI and Tableau covering spending patterns, trip frequency, and demographics
Found that patrons from neighboring states made up a significant share of revenue, and assessed how regional gambling legislation could change that
Recommended loyalty, entertainment, and data-driven marketing strategies to leadership
impact: Delivered strategic recommendations to Gaming Commission leadership
note: Data and visuals were anonymized and modified for portfolio use.

title: NestKeep
subtitle: AI-powered property management for small landlords
description: A platform for landlords with 1–10 units that replaces scattered texts, emails, and spreadsheets with one place for maintenance requests, tenant messages, and property records.
highlights: AI maintenance intake: a conversational assistant asks tenants 3–5 follow-up questions, then fills in the request title, description, and urgency
Predictive maintenance insights scan up to 200 past requests per property to surface recurring or escalating issues
Three-layer urgency detection combines AI classification, a database keyword safety net, and landlord override so leaks, gas, fire, and no-heat issues are never missed
Presented market sizing (90% of U.S. landlords own 10 or fewer units) and an AI ethics review covering misclassification, fairness, and privacy
impact: Working prototype with role-based access and tenant/landlord data isolation

title: Stadium Stacks

highlights: Validated the product with focus groups and surveys that set cup size, pack options, and pricing
Pitched First Fidelity Bank and secured a $3,700 startup loan
Sold through campus events, online orders, alumni outreach, and wholesale deals, and reordered inventory four times
Led philanthropy: 315 service hours against a 300-hour goal, and $7,814.63 donated to The Virtue Center
impact: About $25,000 in revenue and $10,629 net income, roughly double the projection
